Process

How a project runs

  1. 01

    Discover / Research

    Define the real problem, the users and the constraints before choosing a technology.

  2. 02

    Engineer / Build

    Design and build across software, electronics and AI, using whichever combination fits.

  3. 03

    Validate / Evidence

    Test against the requirement with data, not assumptions. Evidence before assumption.

  4. 04

    Deliver / Impact

    Ship a working system, document it and support it as it is used.

Common questions

Do I need to know which technology I need?

No. Start with the problem. We evaluate which combination of software, electronics, AI/ML, design or blockchain fits, and explain why.

Can one project combine several services?

Yes. A requirement can move across software, electronics, AI/ML, design, blockchain, research and product engineering within one team.

Where are you based?

Our head office is in Nadiad, Gujarat, India.

How do I start?

Send a short description of your problem through the contact form, by email to contact@kavaiyatech.com or on WhatsApp.
